body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes protocol method signatures in two plugins (`plugin-hono-server` and `plugin-msw`) to align with a recent refactor that changed the protocol interface from individual parameters to structured request objects.

**Changes:**
- Updated 16 protocol method calls in `plugin-hono-server` to use object parameters
- Updated 11 protocol method calls in `plugin-msw` to use object parameters
- Adjusted logging statements to correctly access nested properties in new response structures (e.g., `result.records.length` instead of `result.length`)
- Added `async` keywords to handlers that now await protocol methods that may have become asynchronous
- Removed unnecessary `@ts-ignore` comment that is no longer needed with correct typing

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/hono-plugin.ts | Updated all 16 protocol method calls to use structured request objects (e.g., `{ object, query }` instead of separate parameters) and corrected logging to access nested response properties |
| packages/plugins/plugin-msw/src/msw-plugin.ts | Updated all 11 protocol method calls to use structured request objects and adjusted logging statements to match new response structure with `records` array |
